insight.headline: Order Tax Recalculation
insight.what_changed: The orderUpdate GraphQL mutation now recalculates taxes when the shipping address is updated for unfulfilled orders. This change ensures accurate tax calculations based on the new shipping destination. The update applies to API version 2026-10 and later.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderUpdate mutation should be aware of this change and test their applications to ensure compatibility. No code changes are required, but it's essential to verify that tax calculations are correct after updating the shipping address. The orderUpdate mutation is part of the GraphQL Admin API, which is used in various Shopify applications, including those built with Hydrogen, Remix, and React Router.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will benefit from accurate tax calculations, reducing potential errors and discrepancies. This change improves the overall shopping experience and helps merchants comply with tax regulations.
insight.why_it_matters: Accurate tax calculations are crucial for merchants to avoid errors and ensure compliance with tax regulations. This change enhances the reliability of Shopify's tax calculation system, providing a better experience for both merchants and customers.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query performance data on behalf of authorized merchants.
CLI version 4.6.1 now serves UI extension source maps during app development, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, allowing for more flexible and dynamic cart management.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being moved from reserved to committed, changing how in-progress inventory holds are represented.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: WebMCP support is now available for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing developers to deploy Hydrogen storefronts to Oxygen from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, improving order management capabilities.

updates.title: Updated Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps
updates.summary: Built for Shopify requirements for Fulfillment services apps have been updated, making it easier for apps to achieve Built for Shopify status.

updates.title: Hydrogen developer preview update: July 30, 2026
updates.summary: The Hydrogen developer preview has been updated with new capabilities, including Vue bindings, extending the ways developers can build Shopify storefronts.

updates.title: New fields for cash management activities and drawers in POS
updates.summary: New fields are now available on cash management resources in the GraphQL Admin API, providing more detail about cash drawer balances and cash count activities.
CLI version 4.6.0 has removed deprecated draftable extension process and dev session support branching, improving the development experience.

updates.title: Merchants now see partner details on collaborator requests
updates.summary: Merchants can now see partner details on collaborator requests, providing more context for decision-making.

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance performance data, storefront events, and inventory management

themes.title: Performance Data and Analytics
themes.detail: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, enabling analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants. This update enhances the capabilities of apps using the GraphQL Admin API.

themes.title: Storefront and Inventory Management
themes.detail: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, and draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is being consolidated from reserved to committed. WebMCP support is also added for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts, allowing AI agents to interact with online stores.
